report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46, F, Medicaid with transportation benefit, home tract 17031300900) screened positive for utility shutoff risk and transportation need. Utilities: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in Tuesdays), Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based gas/electric help, apply in person Mon/Wed), and a medical certificate request form for shutoff protection (physician completes). Transport: Medicaid Ride Line (call number on card ≥2 business days before appointments; she is eligible via Medicaid transport benefit), ADA paratransit certification by phone (up to 21-day decision). Senior Shuttle West is not age-eligible (requires 60+). Local tract has 53 transit stops within 800m and early-morning service available.
